ideas.name: Days-to-Cover Long Short Deciles
ideas.claim: Sort US stocks by days to cover, buy the lowest decile and short the highest decile, rebalancing after each short-interest report.
ideas.quote: The bottom decile by days to cover trailed the average by 6.8% a year, so the classic long-short (buy the least shorted, sell the most shorted) lost 4.5% a year.

rules.timeframe: Daily data; portfolios rebalanced approximately twice monthly
rules.entry: At the close of the first trading day at least 10 calendar days after short-interest settlement, buy the lowest days-to-cover decile and short the highest; equal-weight each decile.
rules.filters: Broad universe: price at least $5 and daily volume at least 100,000 shares; liquid universe: price at least $10 and daily volume at least 1,000,000 shares.

ideas.claimed_result: Broad-universe long-short return was -4.5% annualized for 2018 through 2026-09-10, gross of trading and borrowing costs.
required_data: Point-in-time FINRA short interest and settlement dates
Historical listed and delisted stock universe

ideas.name: Rising Short Interest Squeeze Screen
ideas.claim: Heavily shorted stocks with rising short interest and relative price strength averaged a positive return relative to SPY over the following 20 days in the reported test.
ideas.quote: Short interest up more than 5% vs the prior report, the stock beating SPY by 3%+ over 20 days, and trading above its 20-day average.

rules.entry: Screen for short interest up more than 5% versus the prior report, 20-day return at least 3% above SPY, and price above its 20-day average; the page describes this as a watch-list trigger.
rules.exit: not stated; performance measured over 20 days
rules.filters: Short interest at least 6% of shares outstanding or in the top 8%, and days to cover at least 3.

ideas.claimed_result: Average return relative to SPY was +2.9% over 20 days with a 52% relative win rate in the January 2024–October 2026 out-of-sample test; the page reports survivorship bias and excludes fees and slippage.
required_data: Point-in-time FINRA short interest and publication dates
Daily stock and SPY prices and volume
